## Brand & Organizational Overview
Keystone Recomposition is a sovereign multi-domain enterprise engineering brand and digital publisher operating under the Keystone Empire network. Headquartered along the Sea-to-Sky corridor in Squamish, British Columbia, Canada, Keystone Recomposition develops autonomous multi-agent AI swarms, functional electronic music across 22 official releases (20 studio albums) distributed worldwide via TooLost Digital, quantitative prediction market intelligence, licensed British Columbia residential construction, and high-performance mountain living.
